text:
maya: Heads-up — AcmeOps asked for a shadow variant of `redwood-instruct-13b` tuned for their internal docs. Requirements: instruct-style LM, 64k context, int8 quantized candidate, need perf numbers and a QA rubric. They want a canary by EOW. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
dan: Thanks Maya — what's the priority compared to the current backlog? any SLA/latency targets from them?
maya: They said <200ms p95 for short prompts and ~1.2s for long-context token generation (amortized). Priority is medium-high; revenue impact if we miss rollout windows.
lee: OK. Proposed plan: 1) bring up base 13b longctx build (FP16) 2) run correctness evals vs instruct baseline (tox, rouge, customized prompts) 3) int8 sweep (LLM int8/ptq) 4) perf benchmarks + cache/batch tuning 5) canary shadow route on dedicated pool.
sofia: For QA rubric, I suggest: a) instruction-following accuracy (10 curated dialogs) b) hallucination checks vs doc KB (retrieval eval) c) prompt sensitivity (3 paraphrase tests) d) output length/format compliance tests. We'll need golden references from AcmeOps — do we have their prompt set?
maya: They uploaded a 120-sample prompt pack to the S3 link earlier. I'll share in thread.
lee: Nice. I'll start with model bring-up checklist. Quick note: longctx 64k requires config tweaks: `--max-seq-len 65536 --kv-cache-shard 8` and we should set `prefill_chunk=4096` for perf.
dan: infra constraints: Dedicated pool for canary is available but int8 builds need nightly quant nodes (q-box). We need a capacity ticket. @infra-bot can you provision q-box-2 for 2h windows this week?
infra-bot: Provision request received. ETA 2024-04-06 14:00 UTC. Reservation id: res-ACME-0424.
lee: I'll kick off a baseline accuracy run today. Command I'm using: ```
python eval/run_eval.py --model redwood-instruct-13b-longctx-fp16 --prompts s3://acme/prompt_pack.json --metrics fidelity,bleu,qa_halluc
```
sofia: Add evaluation for safety/PII redaction — Acme flagged legal regs. Also include a metric for unexpected token leakage.
maya: For quantization experiments: start with GPTQ int8 on a dev shard, check perplexity delta < 3% and task accuracy drop < 2%. If it fails, try PerChannel vs PerTensor and int8_steal fallback.
lee: Noted. I'll iterate: FP16 -> GPTQ-int8(opt) -> fallback int8(naive) and log deltas. I'll post perf numbers + sample diffs here.
dan: For rollout policy: canary at 1% shadow (no routing), monitor cost/latency, qa failure rate. If failure_rate > 1.5% or latency > target for 5m window, auto-rollback. Who owns alerting?
sofia: I'll add eval monitors in Redwood Console (per-route QA, delta alerts) and add a Slack alert channel for the canary.
maya: OK team — timeline: baseline runs today (lee), quant sweep tom, QA rubric ready tomorrow (sofia), infra all set. If we can get a green smoke by Thu, coordinate canary Fri morning.
lee: Starting the baseline now. Posting results here after first pass. :runner: 
sofia: If anyone needs prompt variants from Acme (redacted), ping me — I scrub and upload.
dan: Thanks all — keep updates short in thread. Maya, tag me if we need exec priority.
maya: Will do.
lee: 1715000123 infra log: baseline FP16 run complete — p95 latency 180ms short, 1.05s long amortized. Accuracy vs instruct-baseline: +0.9% micro-F1. Uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-test/acme/1715000123/
sofia: :eyes: that's promising. Next: GPTQ 8-bit sweep tonight.
maya: Great work — keep the canary checklist updated in the shared doc (link pasted).
